observations: Following TP08, the regression.csv sidecar and regression-reference.graph.json imported an editable Graph with eight original rows; row_8 probed at x=7.00000, y=15.2000.

Linear regression on Reference data reported n=8, excluded=0, df=6, residual SD=0.23094011 and R²=0.99809886. Its centered/scaled equation was z=(x-3.5)/3.5; y=8.0000000 + 7.0000000*z^1, equivalent to y=2*x+1.
All eight displayed residuals were +0.2 or -0.2, so their squared sum is 0.32. The UI did not directly display an SSE value in this walkthrough.
The plot showed a brown fit, purple dashed mean-response limits and purple dotted new-observation limits. The panel identified them as 95% pointwise, not simultaneous, with no extrapolation.

Importing gaps.csv through Android's file picker and applying those replacement rows removed the previous transient fit because the picker backgrounded the app. Undo restored the eight-row data. After rerunning the fit, entering replacement rows directly in the app and applying them displayed Stale result — inputs or source changed; run again. The old n=8 fit remained visible as stale.
scope: TP14 passed on the independent Notes Check APK. SSE=0.32 follows from the eight displayed ±0.2 residuals; the UI did not print SSE directly. The distinct 95% mean-response and new-observation limits were visually checked; their numerical report/CSV export remains TP11 publication work. Data edits affected only an independent Graph copy after the TP08 export was captured.
